items.title: Stop paying for Microsoft Office — LibreOffice 25.2 is free and opens every file you have
items.summary: LibreOffice 25.2 gives you Writer, Calc, Impress, Draw, Base, and Math — completely free, no subscription. Download the Windows installer at libreoffice.org (choose 64-bit MSI). It opens .docx, .xlsx, .pptx and saves back to those formats.

items.title: Get free remote help built into Windows — Quick Assist lets someone you trust see and control your PC
items.summary: Windows 11 includes Quick Assist — a free, built-in tool for safe remote help. No download, no account, no third-party software. Open Start, type Quick Assist, click Help someone, share the 6-digit code.

items.title: Copy multiple things, paste any of them — Windows Clipboard History is free and built in
items.summary: Press Windows key + V to open Clipboard History. If off, click Turn on. Now every copy (Ctrl+C) saves text, links, small screenshots. Press Win+V to see last 25 items and click any to paste. Pin frequent snippets.

items.title: Stop reusing passwords — Bitwarden is the free password manager that works on every device
items.summary: Bitwarden gives you a free, open-source password vault that syncs across Windows, Mac, Linux, iPhone, Android, and every browser. Create one free account at bitwarden.com, install the browser extension and mobile app. Save one master password — Bitwarden generates, saves, and fills the rest.

items.title: Talk to your computer and it types for you — Windows Voice Access is free, built in, and works offline
items.summary: Windows 11 includes Voice Access — dictate text, click buttons, navigate menus, control your PC by voice. Press Windows key + Ctrl + S to start. First run downloads ~50 MB speech model, then works completely offline — no internet, no account, no data sent to Microsoft.

items.title: Firefox 159 adds Smart Window price-watch and sidebar passwords — free update at firefox.com
items.summary: Firefox 159 adds Smart Window to watch pages for price drops, puts saved passwords in the sidebar, and uses native macOS sharing. Update free at firefox.com or Menu → Help → About Firefox.

items.title: Fiber internet expanding in Lake City — Clearwave Fiber now at 20% availability, check your address
items.summary: Clearwave Fiber reaches 20.3% availability in Lake City with speeds up to 7 Gbps. AT&T Fiber at 80%, Xfinity at 68.8%. Check your address at broadbandnow.com/Florida/Lake-City or clearwavefiber.com.

items.title: Windows has free built-in troubleshooters for internet audio printer and updates — no download needed
items.summary: Windows 11 includes free troubleshooters for internet, audio, printer, Windows Update, and more. Find them at Settings → System → Troubleshoot → Other troubleshooters. Click Run next to any problem area.

items.title: Windows can stop ransomware from encrypting your files free — Controlled Folder Access is built in
items.summary: Windows 11 has a free ransomware shield called Controlled Folder Access. It blocks unauthorized apps from encrypting your Documents, Pictures, and other folders. Turn it on: Settings → Privacy & security → Windows Security → Virus & threat protection → Manage ransomware protection → On.
